# 2 Baruch Chapter 26 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Second Fast and Dialogue

---

**26:1** And I answered and said: Will that tribulation last a long time, or will that distress grip the earth for many years?

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering of a single-verse chapter. Minor variation between translators: EMET "grip [them]," LOGOS "hold the earth," PNEUMA "hold the world in its grip." Adopted LOGOS/SOPHIA synthesis "grip the earth" — active verb combined with earthly scope.*
